protocol_owner: People merge producer; each consumer owns its collision and inverse proof
registration_contract: Every declared Person FK and frozen Person reference must match the adopted schema. Merge locks exact same-owner identities and consumers; preview collisions, preserve immutable evidence and private authorship, record exact prior/result revisions, refuse unsafe inverse. A FK or historical snapshot grants no access.

person_references.meaning: Organization or plant Person reference under exact immutable owner; linked account grants are separate.
person_references.lock_order: Lock owner and live same-owner source/survivor Persons in UUID order, then consumer row; new references take the same lifecycle locks.
person_references.merge_policy: Preserve original historical endpoints; refuse conflicting linked accounts, duplicate active same-program enrollments or cross-owner collisions. Never transfer consent, private content or authorship.
person_references.inverse_policy: Guard exact prior/result revisions and refuse new reference, changed feedback/completion or irreversible disclosure; no partial inverse.
person_references.retirement_policy: Stop new current references after retirement, merge or removal. Active duties and enrollments require reviewed resolution; retain only necessary facts under removal policy.
person_references.privacy_policy: No transfer of account grants, private reading/documents/care or staff-note visibility.
person_references.immutable_evidence_policy: Original actor, occurrence and correction evidence stays immutable.

person_references.meaning: Merge lineage: the source and survivor of one reviewed merge.
person_references.lock_order: Lock owner and live same-owner source/survivor Persons in UUID order, then consumer rows; reference inserts take the same Person locks.
person_references.merge_policy: Immutable lineage of an earlier merge; never moved. A chained merge changes the survivor revision, so the earlier Unmerge is refused.
person_references.inverse_policy: Unmerge marks the row reversed; it is never rewritten to another Person.
person_references.retirement_policy: Lineage stays while either Person exists and goes with it on purge.
person_references.privacy_policy: Holds reviewed Person field values for Owners and Admins only; never in central audit.
person_references.immutable_evidence_policy: Original actor, occurrence and correction evidence stays immutable.

person_references.lock_order: Lock owner and live same-owner source/survivor Persons in UUID order, then consumer rows; reference inserts take the same Person locks.

person_references.meaning: Correction history of a record of this Person.
person_references.lock_order: Lock owner and live same-owner source/survivor Persons in UUID order, then consumer rows; reference inserts take the same Person locks.
person_references.merge_policy: Moves with its record to the survivor; the correction keeps its original corrector and values.
person_references.inverse_policy: Moves back with its record on a guarded Unmerge.
person_references.retirement_policy: History stays under current permission and goes with the Person on purge.
person_references.privacy_policy: Private qualification values stay in plant history; never in central audit.
person_references.immutable_evidence_policy: Original actor, occurrence and correction evidence stays immutable.

person_references.meaning: An explicit dated withdrawal or reactivation of this Person's commitment.
person_references.lock_order: Lock owner and live same-owner source/survivor Persons in UUID order, then consumer rows; reference inserts take the same Person locks.
person_references.merge_policy: Moves to the survivor, whose commitment is recomputed from both Persons' cards and changes.
person_references.inverse_policy: Moves back on a guarded Unmerge; each Person's commitment is its own again.
person_references.retirement_policy: No new change for a retired or merged Person; history stays under current permission and goes with the Person on purge.
person_references.privacy_policy: Holds only the kind and date; the actor stays in the audit row.
person_references.immutable_evidence_policy: Original actor, occurrence and correction evidence stays immutable.

person_references.meaning: Saved person and program applicability. A merge moves every episode to the survivor.
person_references.lock_order: Lock live same-plant source and survivor in UUID order, then the assignment row.
person_references.merge_policy: Move the assignment to the survivor. Do not put both people on one active episode of the same program.
person_references.inverse_policy: Unmerge moves the assignment back when the reviewed survivor revision still matches.
person_references.retirement_policy: Operational rosters list live people only. The episode row remains.
person_references.privacy_policy: Assignment movement never transfers account grants, private care, or mail.
person_references.immutable_evidence_policy: Ended episodes keep their dates. A merge moves the row. It does not rewrite the dates.

person_references.meaning: Append-only earned, revoked, or service evidence. A merge leaves it on the source person.
person_references.lock_order: Lock live same-plant source and survivor in UUID order. Do not rewrite the credit.
person_references.merge_policy: Keep the credit on the source person. Do not move historical completion.
person_references.inverse_policy: Unmerge does not move the credit, because the merge did not move it.
person_references.retirement_policy: Operational selectors omit a retired person. The credit row remains under that person.
person_references.privacy_policy: Credit evidence never transfers account grants, private care, or organization person evidence.
person_references.immutable_evidence_policy: Verifier, earned date, and kind stay as written. Revoke and redo append rows.

person_snapshot_references.policy: Person-kind record identity stays frozen on merge and Unmerge; never retarget the stored reference or rewrite original evidence. Current reads resolve merged_into_person_id under current same-plant permissions, and retirement blocks new operational references. Unmerge follows the current guarded identity; it does not replay effects, jobs, notices or disclosures. Execution rechecks original source/target revisions and refuses stale reviewed intent. Person movement transfers no account grants, private authorship or conversation ownership. Preserve original job uniqueness and producer key; stale source revisions supersede work instead of creating a replacement under the survivor.

Person-kind record identity stays frozen on merge and Unmerge; never retarget the stored reference or rewrite original evidence. Current reads resolve merged_into_person_id under current same-plant permissions, and retirement blocks new operational references. Unmerge follows the current guarded identity; it does not replay effects, jobs, notices or disclosures. Execution rechecks original source/target revisions and refuses stale reviewed intent. Person movement transfers no account grants, private authorship or conversation ownership. Recheck the current audience and source eligibility before display or dispatch; never duplicate or resend a notice on identity movement.

Body-free removed Person identity in the exact organization. Restore reapplies this witness before reopening current records, historical projections or bytes. Never resurrect contact/note/feedback/merge snapshots or consent; retained identity grants no access.

Frozen bounded original Person projection, including linked-account identity and lineage. Do not retarget on merge or Unmerge, transfer grants or replay effects. Fresh same-owner authorization precedes reads/replay; witnessed organization/account removal scrubs private bodies and identity before recovery.

Protected changed-field Person history and exact replies retain original owner and actor attribution. Current Person removal scrubs bodies and request replies; record identity confers no current access.
The corrected assessment, interview or commitment record; never a Person. The record identity stays frozen on merge and Unmerge, and the correction moves with its record's Person.
